headline: Executive order sets up a White House initiative focused on Historically Black Colleges and Universities.
what_it_does: This executive order creates or continues a White House initiative aimed at promoting excellence and innovation at Historically Black Colleges and Universities (HBCUs). No summary of the order's details was provided, so specific actions, funding, or deadlines are not known from this source.

who_it_affects.how: The schools are the focus of a White House effort meant to support their quality and innovation.
They may be affected by any programs or support that come from the initiative, though details are not given here.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed April 23, 2025; executive orders usually take effect when signed.
